component.name: gknowledge
component.summary: Turn documents into a living wiki

description.p: gknowledge is a native GNOME workstation for knowledge curation. It helps you collect documents, notes and links, then incrementally transforms that corpus into a structured, inspectable knowledge base with the help of pluggable LLM providers.

ul.li: Source-centric, local-first project format (readable Markdown + SQLite index)
Two-step LLM extraction with provenance and cross-links
Works fully offline with local heuristics — no API key required
Persistent, cache-aware ingestion queue with crash recovery
Assisted querying with citations back to your sources

description.p: A wiki that knows when it is out of date.

ul.li: Sources whose original file changed since ingestion are marked, and can be updated in one click
Re-ingest or remove a source; knowledge it alone supported is cleaned up
PDF import works in the Flatpak
Clicking a document in the sidebar opens it

description.p: The app icon shows again in the dock and app grid.
Packaging fixes: the .deb no longer ships the shared icon cache, and the installer works with apt's sandboxed download.
Agents, a cleaner wiki and a readable app.

ul.li: MCP server: Claude Code, Codex and Cursor can search, read and grow the wiki
Pages render as formatted Markdown with clickable links, citations and backlinks
Fewer, better pages: no empty stubs, duplicates merged, names kept as written
ChatGPT model picker and a visible warning when the model fails
Native GTK 4 and Libadwaita workspace with a Nautilus-style sidebar
Offline ingestion, linked Markdown wiki with provenance, cited answers
Sign in with ChatGPT to use your own plan, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint
Review queue, demo projects and a .deb package
